tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Domain WHOIS via RDAP ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Registrar, IANA id, creation/update/expiry dates, age and days to expiry, EPP status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC and any non-redacted contacts, from the authoritative registry RDAP server (plus the registrar RDAP for thin TLDs like .com)

tools.name: domain_age
tools.description: Domain age and expiry ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Creation date, age in days/years, expiry and days to expiry for up to 20 domains (RDAP). For fraud scoring, lead qualification and phishing triage. underscoredone domain-age-checker charges $0.01. HTTP POST https://mpp-domain.fmf-x402.w

tools.name: domain_available
tools.description: Bulk domain availability check ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Is it registered? Up to 20 names (or one name x up to 20 TLDs via "tlds") checked against registry RDAP; returns available / registered / unknown, with expiry for registered names. Premium/reserved names can show as available;

tools.name: http_status
tools.description: HTTP status + redirect chain checker ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). For up to 10 URLs: every redirect hop (status, Location, ms), final status, final URL, content-type, server, total time, and flags (redirect loop, http->https, too many hops). Uptime checks, link rot, SEO redirect audits.

tools.name: http_security_headers
tools.description: HTTP security headers grade ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Fetches a URL (following redirects) and grades HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and COOP: score 0-100, A-F grade, per-header pass/missing/weak with fixes, plus leaked Server/X

tools.name: email_auth
tools.description: Email authentication audit (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX, BIMI, MTA-STS) ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_available, email_auth · Private data: domain_whois, email_auth · Public sink: domain_whois, domain_age, domain_available, http_status, http_security_headers, email_auth.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_available, email_auth · Private data: domain_whois, email_auth · Public sink: domain_whois, domain_age, domain_available, http_status, http_security_headers, email_auth

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
